units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 30b:10">R. Hash. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי שיהא … שלא בש׳</he> so that there be time enough to offer … and to sing the appropriate psalm without confusion.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 30b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כיון דלא אמור כלל אין לך ש׳ וכ׳</he> since they recited no song at all (on account of the late hour), there could be no greater confusion than this.
